mola.mechanism: loop block attention at loop r reads [prev-loop K/V (j<=t), current-loop K/V (j<=t)] in one shared softmax; no separate gate
mola.mask_form: prev-loop KV at positions j<=t (MoLT-KV-style prefix memory)
mola.prev_kv: post-rotary, single previous loop only, reused without re-rotation
mola.gradients: flow through cross-loop KV (loop forcing, 1:1 loop-loss weights)

load: build LoopedStudent from modeling_looped.py with the teacher, then load_state_dict(torch.load('student_state.pt'))
